description: A tall pinkish carved stone slab with an arched top, filled with relief figures. At the top, a horned, bow-carrying figure stands on a mountain beneath star disks, a crescent and a sun. Below, rows of spear-carrying soldiers march in file, and on the lower right a heap of prone figures lies among the rocks. The background is dark, with torch flames at both side edges, in an oil-painted style.
